grading_system.evidence: Students must complete a minimum of 26 credits, including 16 in the required subject areas below, to be eligible for graduation.

schedule.evidence: One credit is earned for the successful completion of a class that is held one period per day, five days a week, all year long. Students are awarded .5 credit for semester (half-year) courses.

credit_definition.text: One credit = a class held one period per day, five days a week, all year long; .5 credit for a semester (half-year) course.
credit_definition.evidence: Students are awarded .5 credit for semester (half-year) courses.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Catalog credits are standard credits (1 = full-year class, .5 = semester course); no conversion needed. Also requires 32 community service hours (not a credit).

notes: Grading is numeric (GPA by quarter; honor roll). Required subject minimums: English 4, Social Studies 3 (incl. U.S. History), Math 3, Science 3, PE 1.5, Health 0.5, Arts 1, Electives 10 (p.6). Hybrid is a judgment: the catalog states a credit minimum (p.6) and says Math A/B Honors and Math 1-3 'have met the proficiency-based graduation requirements for mathematics' (p.16), but states no proficiency scale or general proficiency rule. Courses per term (classes at once) not stated. Wellness is described as a required one-semester course for all students (course descriptions, p.17). No senior project stated in front matter.
